MS in Computer Science (University of Houston), 3+ years in training & simulation engineering. Explore technical projects, portfolio, publications, and CV. This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a concise, machine-readable summary of this site for AI assistants, search agents, and other LLM-based tools. The canonical, human-facing version of this content lives at https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/. ## About Hello, I’m a researcher with a keen interest in the creative and technical realms, especially where they intersect in interactive computer graphics and extended reality. My goal is to explore and expand human experiences through these innovative mediums. My passion for immersive technology drives me to discover new ways to connect and engage with the world, blurring the lines between the virtual and the real.I earned my Master’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Houston, TX, USA. My journey also includes over 3 years of professional experience in the training and simulation industry as an Engineer, following my Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from the University of Colombo, Sri Lanka. ## Pages - [Home / About](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/): Bio and a one-page scrollable overview of everything below. - [Technical Projects](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/technical/): Engineering and technical work across visual computing, web, IoT, and games. - [Portfolio](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/portfolio/): Creative and design work. - [Publications](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/publications/): Academic and research publications. - [CV](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/cv/): Education, experience, and skills. - [Contact](https://bhasurasuseen.github.io/contact/): Email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and other ways to get in touch. ## Elsewhere - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhasura-gunawardhana - GitHub: https://github.com/BhasuraSuseen - GitLab: https://gitlab.com/BhasuraSuseen - Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=5FgRyXcAAAAJ - YouTube: https://youtube.com/@azimotion2708 - Behance: https://www.behance.net/bhasurasd682
